unit.why: Three short, separate anecdotes about R. Menachem Mendel of Rymanov: his absence on a Shabbat, when he was at the imperial court in Vienna; his reciting Hallel for seven days; and a youth kept from apostasy by studying Sefer Haredim.
unit.boundary_note: The heading attributing these to R. Menachem Mendel of Rymanov ends the previous division.

stories.start_quote: פ״א שלח לו עמיתו ורעו הה״ק מלובלין
stories.end_quote: כי אז הי' מוצא אותי שם
stories.summary_en: The Seer of Lublin searched the upper worlds for the Rymanover on a certain Shabbat and could not find him; the Rymanover answered that he had been at the emperor's court in Vienna.

quotes: שלח לו עמיתו ורעו הה״ק מלובלין
כי חפש אחריו בכל המקומות ולא מצאו
tags.why: The Seer's spiritual search for the Rymanover
The disappearance happens on a Shabbat

quotes: למה לא חפש אותי בחצר המלך בוויען
tags.why: His presence at the imperial court, implying intercession

quotes: בחצר המלך בוויען כי אז הי' מוצא אותי שם
tags.why: Implies the tsaddik acts on the community's behalf at the court

missing_concepts: spiritual presence of the tsaddik at a distant location (bilocation / soul-travel to a royal court)

stories.start_quote: פ״א בפ׳ בא אמר כל השבעה
stories.end_quote: כשעברו חז׳ ימים תמהו על הראשונות
stories.summary_en: In the week of Parashat Bo he recited Hallel with the congregation for seven days; no one wondered at the time, but afterwards people were amazed.

quotes: אמר כל השבעה ימים הלל עם הקהל בביהכנ״ס
tags.why: He recited Hallel in the synagogue

quotes: כשעברו חז׳ ימים תמהו על הראשונות
tags.why: People realized the oddity only afterwards
The editor raises the halakhic question of a blessing

missing_concepts: unexplained ritual deviation by a tsaddik

stories.start_quote: בחור א׳ הי׳ רוצה להמיר דתו
stories.summary_en: A young man seized by folly wanted to convert to Christianity; the Rymanover ordered that Sefer Haredim be studied with him, and he returned to his faith.

quotes: בחור א׳ הי׳ רוצה להמיר דתו

tags.why: The remedy is study of a book

quotes: הלומד ס׳ חרדים מסוגל להחזיק הדת
tags.why: The tsaddik's remedy restores the youth spiritually
The tsaddik deals with a would-be apostate

missing_concepts: segulah power of a specific book (Sefer Haredim)
